hints: Start by ruling out numbers at or below 20.
After applying the lower bound, check whether each remaining number divides by 4 without a remainder.

Answer: 24. 24 is greater than 20 and divides evenly by both 3 and 4. Eighteen fails the size and divide-by-4 rules; 14 fails both divisibility rules; 21 fails divide-by-4. Warrant: Lake Leatherwood City Park; disguise: Park naturalist.
